nodes.text: For anyone whose throat swells, bless [him thus]:
'Lord Jesus Christ, through the prayer of your servant Saint Blaise, hasten
to the help of the servant of God, N., and swiftly show your mercy upon him
to the glory and praise of your name, Lord.' After that
say three times: 'Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.'
